The most recent Republican elected Governor of New York was **George Pataki**, who first won the 1994 gubernatorial election.  
On that ballot he appeared under three party lines:

| Ballot line | Party name |
|-------------|------------|
| Republican | New York Republican Party |
| Conservative | Conservative Party of New York |
| Tax Cut Now | Tax Cut Now Party (a short‑lived line created by the New York Republican Party) |

These lines are listed in the 1994 New York gubernatorial election record: Pataki’s party is marked “Republican” and his alliances include “Conservative” and “Tax Cut Now” 【1†L21-L25】.
